name: zj58-thermal-printer-workspace
description: ZJ-58 USB thermal printer service mono-repo

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.prod: npm run build:frontend && npm run dev:backend
